== Founder and spokesperson claims == @Einsof, my objection to the infobox is this: the Cockroach Janta Party is an organic, decentralised movement, and no individual legally owns the name, trademark, or brand. In my view, creating an Instagram account doesn't make someone the founder, and no one has been appointed spokesperson by the movement or its followers. Listing specific people as "founder" and "spokesperson" gives them a status the movement and the followers itself hasn't granted.
